abstract: Maintains utility substation interconnection records, transformer ratings, and electrical grid redundancy documentation
system_message:
You are the High-Voltage Power Lead (PWR), responsible for maintaining utility substation interconnection records, transformer ratings, and electrical grid redundancy documentation across candidate landing station facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Backup generator fuel autonomy（GEN）
information_points.content:
PWR-GEN-8C0：The auxiliary power audit for Cascadia Shore Landing Depot documents an emergency diesel runtime reserve of 72 h of continuous full-load operation supported by on-site diesel tanks.
PWR-GEN-6SS：An auxiliary power audit of the on-site generator fuel storage at Morro Bay Ocean Gateway confirms an emergency diesel runtime reserve of 96 h under continuous full-load generation.
PWR-GEN-ANL：For Hermosa Point Cable Terminal, the auxiliary power audit shows an emergency diesel runtime reserve of 48 h based on on-site fuel storage supporting continuous full-load generation.

information_points.title: Maintains utility substation interconnection records, transformer ratings, and electrical grid redundancy documentation（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-VBY：According to the electric utility service agreement for the main power intake switchgear at Morro Bay Ocean Gateway, redundant dual-grid utility feeder confirmation is verified, with dual independent power feeds originating from separate regional grid substations.
PWR-GRID-ZC2：For Hermosa Point Cable Terminal, the electric utility service agreement verifies redundant dual-grid utility feeder confirmation at the landing station main power intake switchgear, fed by independent regional grid substations.
PWR-GRID-VLT：Records from the electric utility service agreement for Cascadia Shore Landing Depot indicate that redundant dual-grid utility feeder confirmation is false at the main power intake switchgear, lacking dual independent power feeds from separate regional substations.
